review.rationale: Decision safely replaces manual expected review hashes with content-derived local/remote equality (decision, review, and governance SHAs required equal; manual_expected_review_hash_allowed=false). Prior failure (TITMAS-CE-G11B-PR27-POST-MERGE-VALIDATION-HARNESS-BINDING-FAILURE) and its root cause (manual unverified hash entry) are preserved and adjudicated. Successful merge evidence (merge_commit c1d8931930fbae15f96ee6a6ac050b081538c919, parents, tree) is retained. Only unused validation caps are authorized for single execution; all non-authorizations (reclassification, source/test fix, history rewrite, reset, force-push, deletion, revert, new merge, release, deployment, standard/production/commercial readiness) remain false. Standing directive TITMAS-CS-STANDING-001 applies within bounded scope and does not elevate authority.
